confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites and one travel guide, so they are rough, not precise. The cocktail and wine anchors are weak: no Suzhou-specific menu prices were found, so they are estimated from the local beer relationship and hotel-bar benchmarks from other Chinese cities, and they probably overstate independent bars. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and comparable-city context; no accommodation searches or listings were checked. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure the search surfaced (20 March 2026), not a rate from near 19 November 2026, so it is stale. Restaurant prices are for July 2026 but are based on sources of mixed dates. Figures assume roughly 7.2 CNY per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Suzhou's position as a mid-sized Yangtze River Delta city with prices below Shanghai. Restaurant and coffee anchors follow aggregated Suzhou ranges (local meals about RMB 30 to 60, sit-down three-course about RMB 100 per person, cappuccino about RMB 25 to 35). Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor and the hotel-bar benchmarks noted above. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a second-tier Chinese city, benchmarked against general expectations for registered hostels and hotels.
